It proposes integration records only and does not modify production data, select a route, score a reward, assume current Pizazz balances, or manufacture casts, room completions, purchases, or readiness.

safe-death, room-progress, logout, repeatability, active-attention, and account-observation requirements

requirements.location: North of the Emir's Arena, north-east of Al Kharid, in the Kharidian Desert.

minimum_magic_to_enter_lobby.boostability: not a separate documented entry check; level 7 is the Lvl-1 Enchant spell gate for the first usable room activity

all_room_spell_gate.reason: Telekinetic Theatre needs Telekinetic Grab; higher Magic expands Enchanting Chamber spell choices and level 60 permits boosted Bones to Peaches casting

requirements.spellbook: All four room spells are Standard spellbook spells. A spellbook change is an independent observed capability.

location_and_transport: Direct: the Mage Training Arena Grouping teleport is available only after the player has spoken to the Entrance Guardian; current access and teleport readiness remain observed.
Near: ring of dueling to Emir's Arena then run north; ring of the elements to Fire Altar then run north-east; travel on foot from Al Kharid.
The 2024 rework added a bank chest on the upper floor. Its existence does not establish the player's rune, coin, equipment, or pouch inventory.
The Arena sits in the Desert region. Desert travel state, heat protection, transport charges, and route safety remain independently modeled facts.

deterministic_effects: The lobby, Reward Guardian, and rooms can be used while membership is active and each selected spell gate/input is met.
non_effects: Arrival does not grant Pizazz, runes, coin, Magic XP, room progress, Rune pouch, Bones to Peaches, collection-log entries, spellbook state, or combat/readiness conclusions.

entry_inputs.behavior: required for every room spell; player-observed spellbook state
each selected spell consumes its normal runes unless a valid staff/tome/substitute supplies an elemental component; substitutes and charges are observed
needed variably for room-generated shapes, fruit, coins, orbs, and rewards; no inventory capacity is inferred

reusable_setup.item_or_capability: elemental staff, combination runes, or charged tome
reusable_setup.effect: can cover only the corresponding elemental component of a selected spell; it does not cover law, nature, cosmic, blood, or soul requirements unless a current sourced item specifically does so.
the ring's daily rune-free low/high alchemy casts work in the Alchemist's Playground and receive that room's Magic XP; current daily charges are diary/account observations, never assumed.

reusable_setup.item_or_capability: Bones to Peaches spell or tablet
reusable_setup.effect: both can convert MTA graveyard bones after the 2024 rework; only the purchased spell supplies the permanent Standard-spell capability and diary task requirement.

rooms.gate: Magic 33 and a valid Telekinetic Grab cast
rooms.loop: Cast Telekinetic Grab from a non-corner side to pull the Maze Guardian one tile north, south, east, or west through one of ten mazes to its exit square. Each maze needs seven through ten valid pulls.

completion_or_reward_events.plus: normal spell-cast XP and normal selected-spell rune consumption

completion_or_reward_events.event: complete every fifth maze in the persistent streak

rooms.failure_and_progress: A corner cast spends a law rune and still grants spell XP but does not move the guardian. Reset returns the statue to its start. Leaving an incomplete maze starts a new random maze. Reset/exit does not reset the five-maze streak. Logging out returns the player to the lobby and does not retain in-room maze progress.

rooms.gate: Magic 15 for Bones to Bananas, or Magic 60 (boostable) for the spell-version Bones to Peaches; a tablet can perform the room conversion but does not establish spell ownership.
rooms.loop: Collect four successive bones from a cycling pile. The four bone types convert to one, two, three, or four fruit each. Convert them to bananas or peaches, then deposit fruit in wall chutes.

completion_or_reward_events.formula: One Graveyard Pizazz per 16 bananas or per 8 peaches; peaches count as two fruit. A deposit can award at most three Pizazz even when excess fruit still receives XP.

completion_or_reward_events.output: one water, earth, nature, death, or blood rune for each qualifying point award, with the exact rune outcome player-observed

rooms.failure_and_progress: Falling bones can damage the player; other pre-2024 damage sources were removed. Entry forbids bringing eligible convertible bones, bananas, or peaches. The activity is safe for normal accounts: death does not lose items, including deathbank items; Hardcore Group Iron death remains dangerous. Logout retains progress after the 2024 rework.

rooms.gate: Magic level and current runes/substitute for the selected Lvl-1 through Lvl-7 Enchant spell
rooms.loop: Take cubes, cylinders, pentamids, or icosahedrons from corner piles and enchant them into orbs. The indicated bonus shape changes every 24 seconds. Dragonstones spawn near the centre and have a 1/32 search chance from a shape pile.

completion_or_reward_events.formula: gain Pizazz equal to selected Enchant level; every tenth enchanted shape doubles that point award; the indicated shape adds two points after the tenth-shape doubling rule.
awards double the relevant shape-enchant Pizazz; selected-shape and tenth-cast effects remain governed by the room rule.

completion_or_reward_events.outputs: 20 Magic XP per deposited orb and a set of three blood, death, or cosmic runes; exact rune type and count of completed deposit sets are observed.

rooms.failure_and_progress: Shapes and dragonstones are room items. Dropping orbs, missing bonus windows, changing spell tier, dragonstone availability, and deposit completion are execution/observation boundaries. Logout retains room progress after the 2024 rework.

rooms.gate: Magic 21 for Low Level Alchemy or 55 for High Level Alchemy, plus selected spell inputs
rooms.loop: Search six cupboards for minigame leather boots, adamant kiteshields, adamant medium helms, emeralds, rune longswords, or an empty result. Alchemise an item and deposit the resulting room coins into the Coin Collector. Positions and displayed values rotate every 60 seconds; each item receives 1, 5, 8, 15, or 30 coins.

completion_or_reward_events.formula: one Alchemist Pizazz per 100 coins plus ten coins paid to bank per full threshold, 2 Magic XP per deposited coin, and an independent remainder-percent chance of one extra Pizazz; Low and High Alchemy yield the same room-coin value.

completion_or_reward_events.effect: the green-arrow item does not consume alchemy runes; the selected spell's other normal requirements and all result observations remain separate.
automatically deposits remaining activity coins, applying the same point, XP, and bank-coin behavior.

rooms.failure_and_progress: Normal coins, coin pouches, clue scrolls, and clue caskets cannot be brought in; externally created coins are removed and earn no Pizazz. Cupboards are open by default, close briefly at rotation, and permit Take-5 after the 2024 rework. Logout retains room progress after the rework.

completion_or_reward_events.requirements: observed current four Pizazz balances, item-specific prerequisite/ownership state, and player-confirmed shop purchase
completion_or_reward_events.determinism: a shop purchase has an exact stated point subtraction and fixed selected reward; accumulating the balances is not automatically derived from entering or repeating rooms.

failure_and_death.ordinary_account_safety: Each room is a safe activity. A normal-account death does not lose carried items, including items stored in an Item Retrieval Service.
failure_and_death.hardcore_group_iron_boundary: The Wiki explicitly warns that death remains dangerous for Hardcore Group Iron players. No death outcome, health, food, or survival state is inferred.
failure_and_death.teleport_boundary: Teleporting out is not allowed while inside the rooms. Re-entry and travel capability must remain explicit.
failure_and_death.no_global_completion: There is no one-time Arena completion. Each room and reward purchase is repeatable subject to observed input, cap, ownership, and currency state.

persistent_values: four Pizazz balances are persistent currencies subject to caps
Telekinetic five-maze streak persists through reset/exit but not an unfinished maze
purchased rewards and permanent spell unlocks require observation
repeatability.logout_rule: The 2024 rework permits logout with room progress retained in all rooms except Telekinetic Theatre; no elapsed-time advancement or in-progress result is generated by the account model.

currencies.earning_formula: 2 per completed maze; +8 per fifth maze in the persistent streak. Individual casts, correct pulls, maze completion, and balance remain observed.
currencies.spend_behavior: Spent exactly in item-specific four-currency Reward Guardian costs.

currencies.earning_formula: 1 per 16 bananas or 8 peaches deposited, with a maximum of 3 Pizazz per deposit. Room conversion/deposits are player-observed.
currencies.spend_behavior: Spent exactly in item-specific four-currency Reward Guardian costs.

currencies.earning_formula: base points equal selected enchant level; every tenth shape doubles, the selected shape adds 2 after doubling, and dragonstones use the stated double-point rule. Spell selection and executed casts are observed.
currencies.spend_behavior: Spent exactly in item-specific four-currency Reward Guardian costs.

currencies.earning_formula: 1 per 100 deposited activity coins plus an independent percent chance from any remainder. The room-coin value, free cast, selected spell, deposit, and point result remain observed.
currencies.spend_behavior: Spent exactly in item-specific four-currency Reward Guardian costs.

dependencies_and_bypasses.detail: A confirmed MTA purchase yields the permanent three-rune-type storage capability, subject to one-pouch ownership.
A confirmed MTA shop purchase yields the permanent spell unlock, but each cast remains separately gated by Magic, spellbook, runes, and eligible bones.
The permanent spell is required for the diary task; the tablet does not count.
Justine sells a Rune pouch note for 75 LMS points; match participation, points, purchase, note conversion, and ownership remain observed.
Any Slayer master sells Rune pouch for 750 Slayer reward points; task/point history and purchase are observed.
Observed daily Explorer's ring alchemy charges can make valid free alchemy casts in Alchemist's Playground, but do not establish points or use counters.
Purchases can add ten item entries (four wand chain entries, five Infinity pieces, Mage's book) and the Bones to Peaches unlock; each actual log state is player-observed.
The shop is a deterministic acquisition path only after exact observed currency and prerequisite state, unlike an RNG drop.

logout_or_idle_constraints: Telekinetic Theatre requires active spatial inputs; corner casts can waste a law rune and exiting/logging out loses current-maze progress.
Creature Graveyard, Enchanting Chamber, and Alchemist's Playground retain progress on logout following the 2024 rework, but this does not turn their outcomes into passive progression.
No source-backed universal idle interval is asserted; selected spell, room, player execution, damage, inventory, and rotation state all vary.
afk_and_attention.source_boundary: Community labels such as low-intensity, casual, efficient, or AFK are execution advice. This package treats all point earning and outputs as actively observed unless a future measurement model receives explicit player data.

community_strategy_observations.claim: Some Ironman routes obtain Bones to Peaches and Rune pouch together, commonly completing utility purchases before optional equipment.
Unlocking the permanent Bones to Peaches spell before farming Graveyard points can improve the room's point conversion versus Bones to Bananas.
Community guides propose room order, staff choices, MTA plugin/maze aids, world-hopping for free Alchemy casts, and selected Enchant tiers to reduce input cost or time.

state_boundaries: Never infer membership, spellbook, Magic level/boost, room entry, current location, Grouping teleport, bank contents, staff/tome charge, Explorer's ring daily charge, Rune pouch ownership/content, spell unlock, or room readiness.

The factual spell costs and Pizazz formulas may validate player-reported casts/deposits, but the model never accumulates casts, points, XP, runes, coins, fruit, orbs, streaks, or room progress from an activity selection.

A Pizazz cap is a factual storage limit, not proof that the account has the cap or an available balance. Remainder-point rolls, dragonstone search, room-item availability, selected bonus shape, and reward-rune type are not deterministic account outputs.

Shop purchases are deterministic only after explicit observed balances, required prior wand, one-pouch ownership condition, and player-confirmed purchase. No proposed action may turn nominal required points into earned Pizazz.

Collection-log state, purchased equipment, wand-chain exchange state, diary task completion, Bones to Peaches cast, eligible-bone quantity, runes consumed, damage/death, and Hardcore Group Iron survival are report-only.

Existing production actions action:buy-mta-rune-pouch and action:unlock-bones-to-peaches remain canonical for the two modeled utility purchases. A future integrator must amend/reference them rather than create parallel transitions.

conflicts_and_unknowns.detail: Production facts use wiki-mta, wiki-rune-pouch, wiki-bones-to-peaches, and official-summer-sweep-up-slayer-more. This isolated package uses current-suffixed IDs to make date/revalidation explicit; an integrator should map them to canonical source registry records without duplicate claims.

The Arena is commonly summarized as requiring Magic 7 because Lvl-1 Enchant is the lowest room spell. It does not have a universal single minigame-level gate beyond selected room/spell requirements. Do not model an invented global entry action that grants point readiness.

Current sources state dragonstones give double Pizazz and separately specify tenth-shape and selected-shape rules. Preserve the factual statements but do not implement a derived combined-point calculator until an in-game or primary-source test confirms ordering for all combinations.

Wiki/community estimates for total runes, GP, hours, room rates, and optimal methods depend on selected spells, free casts, inventory handling, and execution. They must not be treated as fixed account costs.

The current ordinary Rune pouch is available via MTA, a 75-point LMS Rune pouch note, or 750 Slayer reward points. MTA purchase is blocked by already owning one ordinary pouch; model alternatives as mutually satisfying the ownership goal, not stackable rewards.
The current Collection Log lists ten MTA item entries and one Bones to Peaches unlock. The Rune pouch and shop runes are not MTA collection-log entries.
